entry.title: New: Resolution 303 (2024-2026) (Hawaiʻi County) — Adopted
entry.content:
AUTHORIZES THE MAYOR TO ENTER INTO AN INTERGOVERNMENTAL AGREEMENT WITH THE STATE OF HAWAI‘I, THE COUNTY OF KAUAʻI, THE COUNTY OF MAUI, AND THE CITY AND COUNTY OF HONOLULU FOR THE STATEWIDE MULTI-JURISDICTIONAL DRUG TASK FORCE

Authorizes the Hawaiʻi Police Department to enter into a Memorandum of Understanding to interdict drugs via apprehension and arrest of individuals smuggling and distributing illicit narcotics into the State.
